verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is an AML case-management and screening platform, so measuring alert detection quality is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows alert ingestion, analytics CSV export, audit trails and alert dispositioning. Nothing documents labelled validation sets, detection-quality metrics, or measurement of incorrect clearances (false negatives).

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can measure detection quality and incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases
